system.description:
Requirements: You must have Mastered the Malefactor Class, and must have learned the Exploit skill.

When you use you Action to use the Exploit skill, you may spend an additional @LOSS[10 mp] to focus your Exploit onto only one creature, chosen when you do so. Rather than choosing a Status Effect, all Status Effects are Exploited. At the beginning of your future turns this Conflict the target suffers 【SL × the number of Status Effects on the Target】 damage of the same type as one of your equipped weapons (if none, physical).

This counts as your single Exploited Status Effect. You can use an Action on future turns to begin Exploiting as normal (choosing an applicable Status Effect), or spend 10 Mind Points to change the target of you Merciless Assault to them.
